## GLOSSARY
[g001] Beacon: A pipeline that turns raw sales data into weekly analyst reports. | prep:L6
[g002] Golden set: A fixed list of questions with known answers, run before every release. | prep:L9
[g003] Forecast pipeline: The jobs that produce the weekly demand forecast for each chain. | prep:L5

## ANSWER BANK
[b001] Q (en): Can you tell me about yourself?
SAY: Sure, here is the short version.
- I built Beacon, a reporting pipeline for retail analysts.
- It cut report turnaround from 5 days to 1 day.

[b002] Q (en): What is the hardest data quality problem you have solved?
SAY: One example comes to mind.
- Beacon had a golden set of 140 questions.
- We ran it on every release.

[b003] Q (en): How do you decide when a forecast is good enough to ship?
SAY: I use a fixed test first.
- Run the golden set before each release.
- Compare against the last release.

[b004] Q (en): Tell me about a time you disagreed with an analyst.
SAY: There was one case.
- The analyst wanted raw numbers.
- I showed a cleaned view first.

[b005] Q (en): Why Harbor & Pine, and why now?
SAY: Two reasons.
- You sell forecasts to 38 grocery chains.
- The forecast pipeline is the part I want to own.

[b006] Q (en): How would you handle a late data feed from a chain?
SAY: Keep the report on time.
- Flag the gap.
- Use the last good week.

[b007] Q (en): What would you do in your first month?
SAY: Learn before changing.
- Read the forecast jobs.
- Meet the analysts.
